items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Opens Digital Account API To Third Party Fintechs
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) has launched its Digital Account Opening API, now live through wealth management platform OneVest. The new API supports digital onboarding for advisors and enterprise clients that use OneVest. The rollout expands Schwab's third party fintech integration options and broadens distribution for its custody and platform services. items.title: Wealth Management Stocks Fall After Vanguard Aquires Tech Platform
items.summary: Vanguard's ambition to expand in financial advice is causing some trepidation among investors in the industry's incumbents.  Shares of Charles Schwab and LPL Financial were off more than 2% in morning trading Wednesday after Vanguard announced the acquisition of Altruist, a fintech wealth management platform.  Altruist competes with Schwab to custody assets on behalf of financial advisers, and offers AI tools for tax and financial planning.
